summary: Iter-30 status cleanup regression. (1) Created NEW suite tests/test_iter30_status_cleanup.py with 9 focused tests covering every spec point in the review request: existing RN/SRN/ERN/RKN data uses only the active 12-status set; legacy fields racking_status & racked_at are gone from SRN/ERN; /api/racking-notes/sources exposes no racking_status key (top-level or nested); RN finalize transitions DRAFT->RACKING_NOTE_DRAFT (never FINAL); _is_source_fully_racked correctly blocks 2nd RKN with HTTP 409 once source is fully covered; _compute_ern_status returns PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED (not legacy PARTIALLY_REJECTED) when children have only rejected_qty>0. All 9/9 PASS. (2) Re-ran the full backend regression net: iter27+iter28+iter29_auto_rkn+iter29_edge_cases+iter30 = 78/78 PASS in 108s. (3) Frontend smoke (admin login -> Stock In page, all 4 tabs): only the 12 active labels render (Draft, Racking Note Draft, Partially Racked, Fully Racked, Pending, Partially Received, Partially Accepted, Complete, Recorded->labeled 'Fully Racked'). Zero legacy labels (Final / Racking Pending / Fully Received / Partially Rejected) detected anywhere. Auto-RKN purple AUTO badges still rendering correctly across the RKN list. NO bugs found in the status cleanup itself. ONE context discrepancy with the review request worth flagging — see context_notes.
action_items: (Optional cleanup, not blocking) Stale legacy-status mentions in 3 docstrings/comments in /app/backend/server.py — code returns the correct new values, but the prose still says 'FINAL' / 'PARTIALLY_REJECTED'. Specifically: L508 finalize_receipt_note docstring ('Promote a DRAFT receipt note to FINAL'), L847-855 _recompute_rn_status status-precedence doc-comment ('FINAL : finalized RN with no racking activity yet'), L2000-2008 _compute_ern_status doc-comment ('only rejected > 0 AND pending > 0 -> PARTIALLY_REJECTED' — but the actual code just below now returns PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED for that branch). Same kind of stale prose in /app/backend/models.py L232,L235 SRN docstring still says FULLY_RECEIVED. Refresh prose for clarity to future readers.

(Context mismatch with review request, not a bug) Review request claimed 'fresh slate — all stock-in transaction data wiped'. Actual DB at test time: receipt-notes=42, short-received-notes=16, extra-received-notes=8, racking-notes=40, transactions=14, next RN serial=043 (not 001). Issue/picking/transfer notes ARE empty (counters at 001). preserved counts are also higher than spec (stock-master 245 vs 239, godowns 52 vs 46, racks 103 vs 91, boxes 72 vs 62) — likely repopulated by iter29/iter30 test runs (cleanup fixtures delete created stock_master + godowns/racks/boxes, but the auto-created RNs/SRNs/ERNs/RKNs/transactions from those tests are NOT torn down). NOT BLOCKING because the status-cleanup migration was clearly applied successfully — every one of the 42+16+8+40 docs uses only the new 12-status set, and no doc still has the legacy racking_status/racked_at fields. If main agent specifically wants the next RN to be 001, run a transactional wipe + counter reset (db.counters.delete_many({})) AND patch iter29/iter30 fixtures to delete the RN/SRN/ERN/RKN they create.
critical_code_review_comments: Status migration on startup (server.py ~L4214-4365) correctly maps every legacy value -> new equivalent and $unset's racking_status/racked_at — verified live: 0 of 42 RNs, 16 SRNs, 8 ERNs still have legacy status or fields.

_is_source_fully_racked (server.py L2049) is a clean drop-in for the legacy `racking_status == FULLY_RACKED` check. Verified end-to-end: after recording the auto-RKN to 100% coverage, a 2nd POST /api/racking-notes returns 409 as expected, and the parent RN flips to FULLY_RACKED.

_compute_ern_status (server.py L1999-2033) correctly collapses the legacy 'rejected-only -> PARTIALLY_REJECTED' branch into PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED — verified by iter30 test creating an ERN child with accepted_qty=0,rejected_qty=2 and asserting the parent ERN.status==PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED.
Legacy stale prose only — see action_items[0]. No functional impact.
